skirmish.module.chat.name: Chat
skirmish.module.chat.description: The chat in the mod's style: one rounded panel under the lines instead of a black strip per line; tabs over the open chat (All / Chat / Trade / Events / System) with unread counts; a message repeated within two minutes becomes one with «×3»; lines naming you are marked with a bar; five-line event cards fold into one line. The server's text, colours and links stay, clicks work as usual; the mod writes nothing to chat.
skirmish.module.chat.setting.panel.toolt: One rounded panel under the lines instead of a black strip per line
skirmish.module.chat.setting.opacity.too: How dense the panel is (times the chat's «Text Background» option)
skirmish.module.chat.setting.tabs.toolti: Over the open chat: All, Chat (players), Trade (buy/sell, ads), Events, System. Every message is kept — a tab only picks what is shown
skirmish.module.chat.setting.stack.toolt: The same message within two minutes becomes one with «×N» at the newest place
skirmish.module.chat.setting.mentions.to: A player's message naming you is marked with an accent bar
skirmish.module.chat.setting.cards.toolt: Folds HolyWorld's five-line event card into one line with its kind and coordinates
The time each message came, in front of it
